```{ojs}
// legend (shared) — rainfall cells + card-colour (driver strength) key
rainLegend = {
  const w = 260;
  const cv = html`<canvas width=${w} height=${16}></canvas>`;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    const v = rainDomain[0] + (x / (w - 1)) * (rainDomain[1] - rainDomain[0]);
    const c = pixelColor(v); ctx.fillStyle = c || "#fff"; ctx.fillRect(x, 0, 1, 16);
  }
  const ticks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((t) => Math.round(rainDomain[0] + t * (rainDomain[1] - rainDomain[0])));
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.8em;color:#444">
    <div>${anomaly ? "Rainfall anomaly vs 1991–2020 (mm)" : "Seasonal rainfall (mm)"} — map cells</div>${cv}
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:${w}px">
      ${ticks.map((t) => html`<span>${t}</span>`)}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// per-section card-colour key — responsive to that section's driver selection
cardLegend = (driver) => {
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], s = def.scale;
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.78em;color:#555;margin:0.1rem 0 0.5rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <span>Card colour — <b>${driver.replace(/ \(.*\)$/, "")}</b> phase &amp; strength:</span>
    <span>${def.labels[1]}</span>
    <span style="display:inline-block;width:120px;height:14px;background:linear-gradient(to right, ${cardColor(-s, driver)}, ${cardColor(0, driver)}, ${cardColor(s, driver)})"></span>
    <span>${def.labels[0]}</span>
    <span style="color:#999">(depth = strength)</span>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
md`### Notes
- **Data:** per-pixel monthly PTOT COGs (D409 obs pipeline, \`processing=monthly\`,
  1981-01→2026-04). Each map = one year's seasonal total = sum of the 3 season months,
  window-read to the county. Anomaly subtracts the 1991–2020 climatology COG (same grid).
  2026 excluded (incomplete).
- **Drivers per section:** OND defaults to an **ENSO+IOD composite** (mean of the two
  1991–2020-standardised season indices — OND short rains are ENSO+IOD coupled); MAM
  defaults to **Western-V** (long rains are a weak-ENSO, partly-independent Western-V
  regime). Each section can switch driver + filter by its phase. Thresholds: ENSO ONI
  ±0.5 °C · IOD ±0.4 · Western-V / composite ±0.5 (z).
- **Card:** county-mean rainfall (mm) + driver strength tint (PRGn, not the rainfall blue).
- **Fidelity:** cells match climateRationale (native window read, no smoothing, integer
  fillRect, admin clip). Colour scale locked ${anomaly ? "±300 mm" : "0–900 mm"}.
- **Perf:** ≈ (n years × 3 months × 2 seasons) COG fetches; keep the range tight.
- **TODO:** multi-county; phase-composite view; Phase II biomass/NPP (new source needed).`
```

```{ojs}
currentState = {
  const n34 = drivers.filter((d) => d.nino34_anom_noaa != null);
  const oni = d3.mean(n34.slice(-3), (d) => d.nino34_anom_noaa);
  const asOf = n34.slice(-1)[0].date;
  const dmiRows = drivers.filter((d) => d.dmi_hadisst != null || d.dmi_ersst != null);
  const last = dmiRows.slice(-1)[0];
  const dmi = last ? (last.dmi_hadisst ?? last.dmi_ersst) : null;
  const phase = oni > 0.5 ? "El Niño" : oni < -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "neutral";
  return {oni, dmi, phase, asOf};
}
```

<!-- ---- map engine (CHIRPS monthly COG → seasonal + admin-2 overlay) ---- -->

```{ojs}
geotiffLib = import("https://esm.sh/geotiff@2.1.3")
topojsonClient = import("https://esm.sh/topojson-client@3.1.0")
```

```{ojs}
// Use ONE source (admin-2) for both the county outline/clip and the sub-county
// lines, so the boundaries are at the same simplification level. The earlier
// bug (a2 sub-counties poking outside a coarser a1 county outline — the stray
// triangle) came from mixing a1 (vlowres) with a2 (lowres). The county polygon
// is the DISSOLVE (topojson.merge) of its own a2 sub-counties → exact match.
a2topo = FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a2_africa_simple-lowres.topojson").json()
a2objName = Object.keys(a2topo.objects)[0]
kenA2 = {
  const tc = await topojsonClient;
  return tc.feature(a2topo, a2topo.objects[a2objName]).features
    .filter((f) => f.properties.iso3 === "KEN");
}
```

```{ojs}
countySubs = kenA2.filter((f) => f.properties.admin1_name === county)
// dissolved county polygon (exterior of its a2 sub-counties)
countyA1 = {
  const tc = await topojsonClient;
  const geoms = a2topo.objects[a2objName].geometries
    .filter((g) => g.properties.iso3 === "KEN" && g.properties.admin1_name === county);
  return {type: "Feature", geometry: tc.merge(a2topo, geoms)};
}
```

```{ojs}
ringsOf = (feature) => {
  const g = feature.geometry, out = [];
  const push = (poly) => poly.forEach((ring) => out.push(ring));
  if (g.type === "Polygon") push(g.coordinates);
  else if (g.type === "MultiPolygon") g.coordinates.forEach(push);
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
countyBbox = {
  let xmin = Infinity, ymin = Infinity, xmax = -Infinity, ymax = -Infinity;
  for (const ring of ringsOf(countyA1))
    for (const [x, y] of ring) {
      if (x < xmin) xmin = x; if (x > xmax) xmax = x;
      if (y < ymin) ymin = y; if (y > ymax) ymax = y;
    }
  const px = (xmax - xmin) * 0.08, py = (ymax - ymin) * 0.08;
  return [xmin - px, ymin - py, xmax + px, ymax + py];
}
```

```{ojs}
monthlyDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=monthly/variable=PTOT"
monthlyURL = (y, m) => `${monthlyDir}/PTOT-${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}.tif`
climDir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=climatology/variable=PTOT/period=annual/clim=wmo_1991-2020/stat=max"
seasonMonthsFor = ({OND: [10, 11, 12], MAM: [3, 4, 5]})
YEAR_LO = 1981
YEAR_HI = 2025
```

```{ojs}
// pixel window into the shared monthly grid covering the county bbox — read once.
gridWindow = {
  const gt = await geotiffLib;
  const tiff = await gt.fromUrl(monthlyURL(2000, 1));
  const image = await tiff.getImage();
  const [ox0, oy0, ox1, oy1] = image.getBoundingBox(); // oy1 = north
  const W = image.getWidth(), H = image.getHeight();
  const xres = (ox1 - ox0) / W, yres = (oy1 - oy0) / H;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = countyBbox;
  const px0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((bx0 - ox0) / xres));
  const px1 = Math.min(W, Math.ceil((bx1 - ox0) / xres));
  const py0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((oy1 - by1) / yres));
  const py1 = Math.min(H, Math.ceil((oy1 - by0) / yres));
  return {
    window: [px0, py0, px1, py1], w: px1 - px0, h: py1 - py0,
    bbox: [ox0 + px0 * xres, oy1 - py1 * yres, ox0 + px1 * xres, oy1 - py0 * yres],
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
// boolean in-county mask over the window grid (even-odd ray cast over all rings),
// so the county-mean uses only cells inside the polygon, not the padded bbox.
countyMask = {
  const win = await gridWindow;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = win.bbox, w = win.w, h = win.h;
  const rings = ringsOf(countyA1);
  const inside = (x, y) => {
    let c = false;
    for (const ring of rings)
      for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 1; i < ring.length; j = i++) {
        const xi = ring[i][0], yi = ring[i][1], xj = ring[j][0], yj = ring[j][1];
        if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)) c = !c;
      }
    return c;
  };
  const mask = new Uint8Array(w * h);
  for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) {
    const lat = by1 - (j + 0.5) / h * (by1 - by0);
    for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      const lon = bx0 + (i + 0.5) / w * (bx1 - bx0);
      mask[j * w + i] = inside(lon, lat) ? 1 : 0;
    }
  }
  return mask;
}
```

```{ojs}
loadMonthly = async (y, m, win) => {
  const gt = await geotiffLib;
  const tiff = await gt.fromUrl(monthlyURL(y, m));
  const image = await tiff.getImage();
  const rr = await image.readRasters({window: win.window});
  const src = rr[0], out = new Float32Array(src.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const v = src[i];
    out[i] = (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= -9999) ? NaN : v;
  }
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
seasonalYear = async (season, year, win) => {
  const mons = seasonMonthsFor[season];
  const grids = await Promise.all(mons.map((m) => loadMonthly(year, m, win)));
  const n = win.w * win.h, out = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let s = 0, ok = true;
    for (const g of grids) { const v = g[i]; if (Number.isNaN(v)) { ok = false; break; } s += v; }
    out[i] = ok ? s : NaN;
  }
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
climFor = async (season, win) => {
  const gt = await geotiffLib;
  const tiff = await gt.fromUrl(`${climDir}/PTOT_${season}_1991-2020_mean.tif`);
  const image = await tiff.getImage();
  const rr = await image.readRasters({window: win.window});
  const src = rr[0], out = new Float32Array(src.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
    const v = src[i];
    out[i] = (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= -9999) ? NaN : v;
  }
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
// driver definitions. `composite` = mean of the standardised member indices.
driverOptions = ["ENSO + IOD", "ENSO (Niño 3.4)", "IOD (DMI)", "Western-V (WNP)"]
// `bands` = magnitude cut-points [weak, moderate, strong]; |v| below weak = Neutral.
phaseDefs = ({
  "ENSO + IOD":       {composite: ["nino34_anom_noaa", "dmi_hadisst"], scale: 1.5, bands: [0.5, 1.0, 1.5], labels: ["Wet", "Dry"]},
  "ENSO (Niño 3.4)":  {col: "nino34_anom_noaa", scale: 2.5, bands: [0.5, 1.0, 1.5], labels: ["El Niño", "La Niña"]},
  "IOD (DMI)":        {col: "dmi_hadisst",      scale: 1.0, bands: [0.4, 0.7, 1.0], labels: ["+IOD", "−IOD"]},
  "Western-V (WNP)":  {col: "wnp_std_mam",      scale: 2.0, bands: [0.5, 1.0, 1.5], labels: ["High", "Low"]},
})
```

```{ojs}
// intensity category for a driver value: "<phase> — <weak|moderate|strong>" or "Neutral"
categoryOf = (driver, value) => {
  if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value)) return "—";
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], a = Math.abs(value);
  if (a < def.bands[0]) return "Neutral";
  const intensity = a >= def.bands[2] ? "strong" : a >= def.bands[1] ? "moderate" : "weak";
  return `${value > 0 ? def.labels[0] : def.labels[1]} — ${intensity}`;
}
// full option list for the multiselect (strong → weak, both signs, + Neutral)
categoryOptions = (driver) => {
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], ints = ["strong", "moderate", "weak"];
  return [
    ...ints.map((i) => `${def.labels[0]} — ${i}`),
    "Neutral",
    ...ints.map((i) => `${def.labels[1]} — ${i}`),
  ];
}
```

```{ojs}
// per-year z-score of a driver index's season-mean, standardised on 1991–2020
zByYear = (col, mons) => {
  const byYear = d3.rollups(
    drivers.filter((d) => mons.includes(d.month) && d[col] != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[col]), (d) => d.year);
  const ref = byYear.filter(([y]) => y >= 1991 && y <= 2020).map(([, v]) => v);
  const m = d3.mean(ref), s = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
  return new Map(byYear.map(([y, v]) => [y, (v - m) / s]));
}
```

```{ojs}
// raw season-mean of a single index for a year
rawSeasonMean = (col, season, year) => {
  const rows = drivers.filter((d) => seasonMonthsFor[season].includes(d.month) && d[col] != null && d.year === year);
  return rows.length ? d3.mean(rows, (d) => d[col]) : null;
}
// title label showing raw index value(s) — no category text (state is the card colour)
labelFor = (driver, season, year) => {
  const f = (v) => v == null ? "—" : v.toFixed(2);
  const oni = () => f(rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", season, year));
  const dmi = () => f(rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", season, year));
  const wnp = () => f(rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", season, year));
  if (driver === "ENSO + IOD") return `ENSO: ${oni()} · IOD: ${dmi()}`;
  if (driver === "ENSO (Niño 3.4)") return `ENSO: ${oni()}`;
  if (driver === "IOD (DMI)") return `IOD: ${dmi()}`;
  return `Western-V: ${wnp()}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// driver value + intensity category for one (driver, season, year)
driverSignalFor = (driver, season, year) => {
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], mons = seasonMonthsFor[season];
  let v;
  if (def.composite) {
    const zs = def.composite.map((col) => zByYear(col, mons).get(year));
    if (zs.some((z) => z == null || Number.isNaN(z))) return {value: null, category: "—"};
    v = d3.mean(zs);
  } else {
    const rows = drivers.filter((d) => mons.includes(d.month) && d[def.col] != null && d.year === year);
    if (!rows.length) return {value: null, category: "—"};
    v = d3.mean(rows, (d) => d[def.col]);
  }
  return {value: v, category: categoryOf(driver, v)};
}
```

```{ojs}
// card background by driver strength — PRGn diverging (purple=dry, green=wet),
// NOT the blue rainfall ramp, lightened to a subtle tint.
cardColor = (value, driver) => {
  if (value == null) return "#ffffff";
  const n = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, value / phaseDefs[driver].scale));
  const white = [247, 247, 247];
  const end = n < 0 ? [118, 42, 131] : [27, 120, 55];
  const t = Math.abs(n);
  const mix = white.map((w, k) => w + t * (end[k] - w));
  const soft = mix.map((c) => Math.round(c + 0.45 * (255 - c)));
  return `rgb(${soft.join(",")})`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// years in range matching any selected intensity category (season-scoped);
// empty selection = show all years
yearsFor = (season, driver, cats) => yearsSel.filter((y) => {
  if (!cats || !cats.length) return true;
  const s = driverSignalFor(driver, season, y);
  return s.value != null && cats.includes(s.category);
})
```

```{ojs}
// build per-year panels for a season+driver (DATA step — no facetCols dependency)
buildSeasonPanels = async (season, driver, phaseFilter) => {
  const win = await gridWindow;
  await countyMask; // ensure mask ready before rendering
  const years = yearsFor(season, driver, phaseFilter);
  if (!years.length)
    return [html`<div class="rain-panel-err">No matching years (${(phaseFilter || []).join(", ") || "all"}) in ${yearsSel[0]}–${yearsSel[yearsSel.length - 1]}</div>`];
  const clim = anomaly ? await climFor(season, win) : null;
  const n = win.w * win.h;
  return Promise.all(years.map(async (year) => {
    try {
      let data = await seasonalYear(season, year, win);
      if (anomaly && clim) {
        const out = new Float32Array(n);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
          out[i] = (Number.isNaN(data[i]) || Number.isNaN(clim[i])) ? NaN : data[i] - clim[i];
        data = out;
      }
      const signal = driverSignalFor(driver, season, year);
      return renderRainPanel({season, year, signal, driver, label: labelFor(driver, season, year)},
        {data, w: win.w, h: win.h, noData: NaN, bbox: win.bbox});
    } catch (e) {
      return html`<div class="rain-panel-err">${season} ${year}: ${e.message}</div>`;
    }
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
// LAYOUT step — arrange pre-built panels into an N-column grid (facetCols only)
gridWrap = (nodes) => html`<div class="rain-grid"
  style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${Math.round(facetCols)}, max-content)">${nodes}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
// absolute seasonal total: white -> deep blue (sequential)
rainStopsAbs = [
  {at: 0, rgb: [255, 255, 255]}, {at: 50, rgb: [224, 236, 244]},
  {at: 150, rgb: [158, 202, 225]}, {at: 300, rgb: [66, 146, 198]},
  {at: 500, rgb: [33, 102, 172]}, {at: 700, rgb: [8, 69, 148]},
  {at: 900, rgb: [8, 48, 107]},
]
// anomaly: brown (drier) -> white (0) -> blue (wetter), diverging
rainStopsAnom = [
  {at: -300, rgb: [140, 81, 10]}, {at: -150, rgb: [191, 129, 45]}, {at: -40, rgb: [223, 194, 125]},
  {at: 0, rgb: [245, 245, 245]},
  {at: 40, rgb: [146, 197, 222]}, {at: 150, rgb: [67, 147, 195]}, {at: 300, rgb: [33, 102, 172]},
]
rainDomain = anomaly ? [-300, 300] : [0, 900]
activeStops = anomaly ? rainStopsAnom : rainStopsAbs
pixelColor = (v) => {
  if (v == null || !isFinite(v) || v <= -9999) return null;
  const s = activeStops;
  if (v <= s[0].at) return `rgb(${s[0].rgb.join(",")})`;
  if (v >= s[s.length - 1].at) return `rgb(${s[s.length - 1].rgb.join(",")})`;
  for (let i = 1; i < s.length; i++) {
    if (v <= s[i].at) {
      const t = (v - s[i - 1].at) / (s[i].at - s[i - 1].at);
      const c = s[i - 1].rgb.map((a, k) => Math.round(a + t * (s[i].rgb[k] - a)));
      return `rgb(${c.join(",")})`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```

```{ojs}
renderRainPanel = (spec, raster) => {
  const {data, w, h, bbox, noData} = raster;
  const [bx0, by0, bx1, by1] = bbox;
  const TARGET_H = 180;
  const aspect = ((bx1 - bx0) / (by1 - by0)) * Math.cos((by0 + by1) / 2 * Math.PI / 180);
  const H = TARGET_H, W = Math.max(120, Math.round(TARGET_H * aspect));
  const tx = (lon) => (lon - bx0) / (bx1 - bx0) * W;
  const ty = (lat) => (by1 - lat) / (by1 - by0) * H;

  const colX = new Int32Array(w + 1), rowY = new Int32Array(h + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i <= w; i++) colX[i] = Math.round(i / w * W);
  for (let j = 0; j <= h; j++) rowY[j] = Math.round(j / h * H);

  const canvas = html`<canvas width=${W} height=${H}
    style="image-rendering:pixelated;display:block"></canvas>`;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  const clip = new Path2D();
  for (const ring of ringsOf(countyA1)) {
    ring.forEach(([lon, lat], i) => i ? clip.lineTo(tx(lon), ty(lat)) : clip.moveTo(tx(lon), ty(lat)));
    clip.closePath();
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.clip(clip);
  for (let j = 0; j < h; j++)
    for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
      const v = data[j * w + i];
      const c = pixelColor(v === noData ? null : v);
      if (!c) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.fillRect(colX[i], rowY[j], colX[i + 1] - colX[i], rowY[j + 1] - rowY[j]);
    }
  ctx.restore();

  const ringPath = (ring) => "M" + ring.map(([lon, lat]) => `${tx(lon).toFixed(1)},${ty(lat).toFixed(1)}`).join("L") + "Z";
  const subPaths = countySubs.flatMap((f) => ringsOf(f)).map(ringPath).join(" ");
  const cntyPaths = ringsOf(countyA1).map(ringPath).join(" ");
  const svg = html`<svg width=${W} height=${H} viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}"
    style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none">
    <path d="${subPaths}" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.8"/>
    <path d="${cntyPaths}" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  </svg>`;

  // county-mean over in-polygon, non-NaN cells
  let sum = 0, cnt = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
    const v = data[i];
    if (countyMask[i] && !Number.isNaN(v) && v > -9999) { sum += v; cnt++; }
  }
  const meanmm = cnt ? sum / cnt : null;
  const meanTxt = meanmm == null ? "—"
    : `${anomaly && meanmm > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(meanmm)} mm`;

  const sig = spec.signal || {value: null};
  const coarse = spec.year < 2000
    ? html`<span class="rain-coarse" title="Pre-2000 CHIRPS is spatially coarser (fewer input stations) — cells look blockier. Faithful, not smoothed.">⚠</span>`
    : "";
  return html`<div class="rain-panel" style="background:${cardColor(sig.value, spec.driver)}">
    <div class="rain-title"><strong>${spec.year}</strong>${coarse}
      <span class="rain-mean">${meanTxt}</span>
      <div class="rain-signal">${spec.label}</div></div>
    <div class="rain-stack" style="position:relative;width:${W}px;height:${H}px">
      ${canvas}${svg}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```
